Q. Q. 2 تَطَأْمَنَ [more commonly written ↓ تَطَامَنَ , without ء, and ↓ اِطْمَأَنَّ also (see رَكَعَ)] He stooped, [bent himself down,] or lowered himself; syn. تَطَأْطَأَ. (S and TA in art. طأ, &c.; and R and TA in the present art.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) He was, or became, lowly, humble, or submissive; syn. خَضَعَ. (S and K in art. خضع, &c.: in some copies of each written with, and in others without, ء.) ―
-b3- See also the next paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
